data.headline: Technical Marketing at Epic Games
data.about: I am a Principal Technical Marketer at Epic Games with 30+ years of experience in computer graphics, technical marketing, and go-to-market strategy across DCC tools, real-time rendering, and interactive pipelines. I began my career at Alias in 1995 as an Application Engineer and transitioned into real-time technologies in 2016.At Epic, I work closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams to develop product positioning, messaging, and launch strategies across Unreal Engine and Epic’s broader real-time ecosystem of tools, helping translate complex technology into clear, developer-focused narratives. I previously served as an adjunct faculty member at NYU’s Tisch School of the Arts, teaching rendering and visual effects.

description.text:
I am helping to drive the adoption of Epic Games ecosystem of tools and technologies in all industries.

Product Marketing & Content Development:

-Driving product marketing efforts through end-to-end content creation, from concept to final delivery
-Defining content strategy, messaging, and audience targeting for campaigns and product launches
-Creating content used across keynote presentations (Unreal Fest, GDC), web, and press kits
-Writing scripts and developing narratives that clearly communicate technical value and product positioning
-Leading asset creation including visuals, motion graphics, titles, and supporting materials
-Managing voiceover direction and editing to ensure polished, professional final outputs
-Delivering cohesive, high-impact marketing assets aligned with product and business goals

Other responsibilities include:

-Creating and presenting Unreal Engine workflows and live demos at trade shows, industry events, and customer engagements
-Producing high-quality videos showcasing new features, workflows, and real-world applications
-Planning, hosting, and delivering webinars that educate, engage, and inspire new Unreal Engine users
-Developing and supporting go-to-market strategies for Epic Games’ enterprise initiatives
-Contributing to white papers, articles, and other key marketing deliverables

description.text:
I am helping to drive the adoption of Epic Games real-time technologies in the enterprise space and non-game uses of Unreal Engine

My responsibilities include:
-Create and present Unreal Engine workflows and demos at various trade shows and events.
-Produce videos on new features and workflows.
-Prepare, present, and run webinars to engage and inspire new Unreal Engine users.
-Develop go-to-market strategies for Epic Games enterprise business.
-Assist in the development of white papers, articles, and other marketing deliverables.

-Advise go-to-market strategy for AMD’s CPU group in the professional DCC space.
-Generate DCC workflow presentations for the product launch of AMD’s Threadripper CPU.
-Define, create, and run performance benchmark tests, focused on DCC application workflows.

As a Technical Marketing Manager at Autodesk, I am a subject matter expert in VR/AR, Visualization, Animation, Rendering, VFX, Modeling - Nurbs | Solid | Polygon, Motion Capture, Compositing, and Game Engines. 

My responsibilities included:
- Working closely with various internal teams (product development, campaign, web, sales, PR) to own the overall go-to-market activities for Autodesk's 3D Animation and Digital Content Creation products
- Provide market intelligence and competitive analysis
- Drive the creation of marketing assets and sales tools to support the marketing efforts targeting 3D content creators in the Media and Entertainment, AEC, and Automotive 
-Art directed and managed contractors in the creation of demo assets, Vision Series opening, Maya opening, and Motion Graphics templates.
- Responsible for delivering marketing sales tools and customer-facing assets including product demo videos, trade show presentations, social media content, and field training courses
- Engaging with field teams and customers for technical meetings, training, and evangelism

Produce and present demonstration materials for Maya, MotionBuilder, Mudbox, Flame, Fusion 360, Alias Automotive, Showcase, Autodesk Reality Capture Workflows, and SketchBook Pro,

My responsibilities included:
- Produce video content for product releases and events
- Design and present demos for trade shows such as NAB, SIGGRAPH, GDC,  Autodesk University
- Provide Research and Development with product feature input
- Provide internal training for major Feature Film studios, Nike, Ford, SOM
- Author tutorials and articles for print and online (3DWorld, The Area)
- Interface with customers and hardware partners for special projects (Dell, HP, Nvidia)
